META_DESCRIPTION: Track haircuts, gym memberships, personal care, and self-investment. FincWin's Personal envelope makes self-care spending intentional.
HERO_H1:
Taking care of yourself
is worth budgeting for properly.
HERO_SUB: Haircuts, gym memberships, skincare, therapy, personal grooming — personal care is how you show up in the world. FincWin's Personal envelope helps you invest in yourself without losing track of the total.
PAIN_H2:
Personal care costs more
than you account for.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: The gym membership you barely use but can't cancel
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: $55/month, 12 months of guilt every time you don't go. That's $660/year for access you rarely use. It's easier to track — and cancel — when you can see exactly what you've paid.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: Personal care products that accumulate invisibly
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: Shampoo, conditioner, moisturizer, supplements, skincare routine — the personal care aisle adds $60–$100 per month. It rarely gets counted because it comes out of "groceries."
PAIN_ITEM_3_H3: Therapy and wellness that needs to be non-negotiable
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: $150/session, bi-weekly — that's $300/month. Without a clear personal care envelope, this vital spending gets crowded out by discretionary spending when money feels tight.
FEATURES_H2:
The Personal envelope:
self-care with full financial awareness.
CARD_1_P: Log therapy, gym, and regular grooming as committed recurring expenses. See what's already allocated before you make discretionary personal care purchases.
CARD_2_P: Log personal care products under the Personal envelope instead of groceries. See the true monthly cost of your routines — and decide if they're worth it with full information.
CARD_3_P: Track your personal wellbeing spend as a category you take seriously. Month-over-month trends show whether you're investing consistently in your own wellbeing.
